description: Subscriber base of the telecommunication operators of Kyrgyzstan is a data set listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Communications Regulation and Supervision Service of Kyrgyzstan. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. Its title on the portal is "Абонентская база операторов связи" (Russian). The portal files it under the publisher Communications Regulation and Supervision Service of Kyrgyzstan. Its tags are связь. It offers 7 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
